## README.md
# U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) Datasets

Cloud-optimized publication of geospatial datasets administered by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, hosted on the NRP Nautilus S3 bucket `public-usfws`.

Public URL: <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usfws/>

## Collections

- **[USFWS Critical Habitat (Final + Proposed)](critical-habitat/stac-collection.json)** — ESA-designated critical habitat for species under USFWS jurisdiction.

> The USFWS National Wetlands Inventory (NWI) is published in the separate `public-wetlands` bucket alongside Ramsar and GLWD; it is not duplicated here.

## USFWS Critical Habitat

Critical habitat under the Endangered Species Act for species under USFWS jurisdiction (terrestrial and freshwater). Two layers:

| Layer | Features | Distinct species | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Final | 728 | 462 | Legally designated, in effect |
| Proposed | 49 | 42 | In ESA rulemaking |

**Source:** FWS HQ ES Critical Habitat (ArcGIS Feature Service, item `794de45b9d774d21aed3bf9b5313ee24`). Polygon features only.

> **Marine species and stream-line critical habitat** for salmonids and other species under NOAA NMFS jurisdiction are NOT included here — those are tracked separately under [data-workflows#144](https://github.com/boettiger-lab/data-workflows/issues/144).

> **Spatial accuracy:** every feature carries the note "Please check current species specific shapefile" — the aggregated layer is generalized for visualization. For the legal extent of any single critical habitat designation, consult the species-specific shapefile via [USFWS ECOS](https://ecos.fws.gov/ecp/report/table/critical-habitat.html).

### Assets

| Layer | Type | URL |
|---|---|---|
| Final | GeoParquet | <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usfws/critical-habitat/final.parquet> |
| Final | PMTiles | <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usfws/critical-habitat/final.pmtiles> |
| Final | H3 hex (res 8) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usfws/critical-habitat/final/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |
| Proposed | GeoParquet | <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usfws/critical-habitat/proposed.parquet> |
| Proposed | PMTiles | <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usfws/critical-habitat/proposed.pmtiles> |
| Proposed | H3 hex (res 8) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usfws/critical-habitat/proposed/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

### DuckDB example

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

-- Top species by number of critical-habitat polygons (Final designations)
SELECT comname, sciname, listing_st, COUNT(*) AS n_polys
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usfws/critical-habitat/final.parquet')
WHERE comname != 'No common name'
GROUP BY comname, sciname, listing_st
ORDER BY n_polys DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Pre-compute the H3 cell area at resolution 8 once (square metres):
--   approx 7.37e+05 m² per cell; see h3-guide for exact constants.
-- Approximate critical-habitat area covered by a species, from hex count:
SELECT comname,
       COUNT(DISTINCT h8) * 737327.598 AS approx_area_m2
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usfws/critical-habitat/final/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
WHERE comname = 'Polar bear'
GROUP BY comname;
```

### MapLibre GL JS example

PMTiles `source-layer` is **`final`** for the Final layer and **`proposed`** for the Proposed layer (the last segment of `--dataset` in the cng-datasets workflow).

```js
map.addSource('ch-final', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usfws/critical-habitat/final.pmtiles'
});
map.addLayer({
  id: 'ch-final-fill',
  source: 'ch-final',
  'source-layer': 'final',
  type: 'fill',
  paint: {
    'fill-color': ['match', ['get', 'listing_st'],
      'Endangered', '#dc2626',
      'Threatened', '#f59e0b',
      /* default */ '#9ca3af'
    ],
    'fill-opacity': 0.55,
    'fill-outline-color': '#1f2937'
  }
});
```
